has been accelerated by large-scale pre-trained language models such as
BERT and GPT. Itâ\x80\x99s worth noting that Chinese text correction poses
unique challenges due to the nature of Chinese charactersâ\x80\x94there
are no explicit word boundaries, and many errors involve homophones.
